threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You can spot a newbie by their confused face at the London Fields park's entrance - it's not 'picnic', it's 'pint and chill' now.
Caught a night bus from Brixton last week. A guy was silently eating a full roast from a takeaway box. The smell? A mix of gravy and exhaust!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew I was home when I saw a guy fixing his bike while balancing a falafel plate on his knee, all while chatting with the neighborhood cat.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin can you find a hidden bookshop that doubles as a bar where locals sip cocktails while browsing dusty tomes. It’s the cozy chaos of Kreuzberg.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by how they roll their eyes when someone asks about the BART delays. It's like a rite of passage here.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Just saw a guy juggling on the Muni bus while the driver fumbled with the fare machine. Only in the Tenderloin, right? Classic San Francisco.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often assume all the locals love the bustling Plaça del Sol, but most of us avoid it after dark—too loud, too wild.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell they're new by the way they still ask locals for directions to Parc Güell instead of Googling it.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You can spot a newbie by how they still look for an actual bus stop sign, instead of just following the crowd or the app.
Last night on the 35, a guy tried to impress a girl by rapping to a distracted driver. Neither seemed to notice the rest of us cringing.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw a kid selling lemonade outside the Kottbusser Tor u-bahn entrance, while an old man fed pigeons nearby. True Neukölln magic.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You know it’s a Berlin winter when people start turning U-Bahn stops into outdoor gathering spots. The benches get crowded with folks sipping mulled wine!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a true local by how they automatically avoid eye contact with the BART performers while silently counting the delays.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy on the 31 Balboa serenading the passengers with a ukulele. Just another Tuesday commute in the Tenderloin.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they can find true tapas in Barelona's packed squares, but the best ones hide in local bars where the locals are too busy to Instagram.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They’re the ones still asking for ‘churros’ at the wrong café, oblivious that it’s all about the ‘xuixos’ here.
